mrr.title: Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
mrr.explanation: MRR is the normalized recurring revenue that BillPilot expects to receive each month from all active subscriptions. It includes base plan fees and recurring line items, excluding one-time charges.
mrr.formula: Sum of monthly normalized prices of all ACTIVE subscriptions

arr.title: Annual Run Rate (ARR)
arr.explanation: ARR is the annualized view of your current recurring revenue (MRR × 12). It assumes current subscription levels persist for the upcoming full year.

churn.title: Subscription & Revenue Churn
churn.explanation: Churn represents revenue or subscriptions lost during a specific period when customers cancel, downgrade, or fail to renew.
churn.formula: Lost MRR in period ÷ Starting MRR in period

proration.title: Billing Proration
proration.explanation: When a subscription changes mid-billing period, proration credits unused days of the previous plan and charges for remaining days of the new plan proportionally.

dunning.title: Dunning & Collections
dunning.explanation: Dunning is the automated process of recovering overdue invoices and failed recurring payments through retries and scheduled notification reminders.

reconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
reconciliation.explanation: Matching imported bank statement transaction lines against recorded invoice payments in BillPilot to detect settlements, bank fees, and unmatched cash.
